VariableID:24334:50308.description: Use to show a link has been visited.

VariableID:24334:50309.name: !-nys/color-@/link-visited-reverse
VariableID:24334:50309.description: Use to show a link has been visited on a dark background.

VariableID:24652:8256.description: Use to show a link has been visited.

VariableID:24cb57cefd8c7952ca4977ce3b931.name: !-nys/color-%/surface
VariableID:24cb57cefd8c7952ca4977ce3b931.description: Default surface. Frame background color, card background, and modal background. 🔎: default, base, page background, primary surface

VariableID:3920:8517.name: !-nys/color-@/text
VariableID:3920:8517.description: Primary text color. Use for body copy and headings. MUST meet WCAG 4.5:1 contrast. 🔎: default text, main text, paragraph, body, heading, readable, black, dark gray

VariableID:3920:8518.name: !-nys/color-@/text-weak
VariableID:3920:8518.description: Secondary text. Use for descriptions, captions, and supporting content. 🔎: gray text, meta, label, helper text, subtitle

VariableID:3920:8519.name: !-nys/color-@/text-weaker
VariableID:3920:8519.description: Tertiary text. Use for placeholder text and subtle labels. AVOID for important content. 🔎: light gray, optional

VariableID:3920:8520.name: !-nys/color-@/text-weakest
VariableID:3920:8520.description: Decorative text only. AVOID for readable content - insufficient contrast. 🔎: light, gray

VariableID:3920:8521.name: !-nys/color-@/text-disabled
VariableID:3920:8521.description: Use for disabled or non-interactive text on standard (light) UI backgrounds.. USE only for disabled form elements. 🔎: inactive, grayed out, unavailable, disabled text, not clickable

VariableID:3920:8522.name: !-nys/color-@/link
VariableID:3920:8522.description: Default state color for text-based links. Blue links are used to signify interactivity and act as a universal call-to-action within content. 🔎: blue, hyperlink, clickable

VariableID:3920:8523.name: !-nys/color-@/link-strong
VariableID:3920:8523.description: Hover state color for text-based links 🔎: link hover, mouseover

VariableID:3920:8524.name: !-nys/color-@/link-strongest
VariableID:3920:8524.description: Pressed state color for text-based links 🔎: link pressed, clicked, mousedown

VariableID:3920:8525.name: !-nys/color-@/link-neutral
VariableID:3920:8525.description: Neutral color for text-based links. Neutral links are used for subtle, context-aware navigation (such as menu lists or footers) where the structure already implies they are clickable, or for styling, to reduce visual noise. 🔎: plain link, menu link

VariableID:3920:8526.name: !-nys/color-@/text-reverse
VariableID:3920:8526.description: Primary text on dark backgrounds 🔎: inverted text, reverse text, white text, dark mode, dark background

VariableID:3920:8527.name: !-nys/color-@/text-reverse-weak
VariableID:3920:8527.description: Use for low-emphasis, secondary text on reverse or dark UI backgrounds where the content is still readable but intentionally de-emphasized. 🔎: white, inverted text, reverse text, subtle, dark mode, dark background

VariableID:3920:8528.name: !-nys/color-@/text-reverse-weaker
VariableID:3920:8528.description: Use for very low-emphasis, tertiary text on dark UI backgrounds where the content is optional or supporting and should recede visually. 🔎: inverted text, reverse text, subtle, muted, dark mode, dark background

VariableID:3920:8529.name: !-nys/color-@/text-reverse-disabled
VariableID:3920:8529.description: Use for disabled or non-interactive text on reverse or dark UI backgrounds 🔎: inverted text, reverse text, disabled, inactive, grayed out, unavailable, dark mode, dark background

VariableID:3920:8530.name: !-nys/color-@/link-reverse
VariableID:3920:8530.description: Use for interactive link text on reverse or dark UI backgrounds where links should be clearly identifiable without overpowering surrounding content. 🔎: inverted text link, reverse text, dark mode, dark background

VariableID:3920:8531.name: !-nys/color-@/link-reverse-strong
VariableID:3920:8531.description: Use for high-emphasis interactive link text on reverse or dark UI backgrounds where links need maximum visibility and contrast. 🔎: inverted link, dark mode, dark background, white

VariableID:3920:8532.name: !-nys/color-@/link-reverse-strongest
VariableID:3920:8532.description: Neutral color for text-based links. Neutral links are used for subtle, context-aware navigation (such as menu lists or footers) where the structure already implies they are clickable, or for styling, to reduce visual noise.  🔎: dark mode, dark background, light gray, inverted link

VariableID:3920:8533.name: !-nys/color-@/link-reverse-neutral
VariableID:3920:8533.description: Neutral color for text-based links. Neutral links are used for subtle, context-aware navigation (such as menu lists or footers) where the structure already implies they are clickable, or for styling, to reduce visual noise.

VariableID:3920:8534.name: !-nys/color-#/theme-stronger
VariableID:3920:8534.description: Strongest shade of theme color, used for pressed state on interactive elements. 🔎: darkest, deepest, maximum, button pressed, clicked, brand, core, agency

VariableID:3920:8535.name: !-nys/color-#/theme-strong
VariableID:3920:8535.description: Stronger shade of theme color, used for hover state on interactive elements. 🔎: strong, dark, darker shade, bold, focus, mouseover, emphasis, brand, core, agency

VariableID:3920:8536.name: !-nys/color-#/theme
VariableID:3920:8536.description: Main brand color of NYS. Used for primary actions and interactive elements such as buttons. checkboxes, radio buttons, toggles and agency-specific headers and footers. 🔎: main, primary, brand, core, agency, call to action

VariableID:3920:8537.name: !-nys/color-#/theme-mid
VariableID:3920:8537.description: Mid-range shade of theme color. Use sparingly, since text contrast is not optimal. 🔎: medium, decorative, accent, brand, core, agency

VariableID:3920:8538.name: !-nys/color-#/theme-weak
VariableID:3920:8538.description: Weaker version of the brand color, used as a branded background for areas with lots of text, like the background of the application footer.  🔎: light, background, branded, muted, text background, content background

VariableID:3920:8539.name: !-nys/color-#/theme-weaker
VariableID:3920:8539.description:
!-nys/color-#/theme-weaker
Lighter shade of theme color, used to subtly convey brand in components with dark text, such as the global agency footer and hover state of the secondary button. 🔎: background, brand, core, agency, accent, lighter, subtle, tint

VariableID:3920:8540.name: !-nys/color-#/theme-faint
VariableID:3920:8540.description: Faint shade of the theme color. Good for subtle accents or backgrounds. 🔎: theme faint

VariableID:3920:8541.name: !-nys/color-#/accent
VariableID:3920:8541.description: Bold accent color for highlighting or emphasis. For use in the NYS Alert component for warning messages. Use sparingly, especially in contexts where it can be confused with warnings or errors. 🔎: yellow

VariableID:3920:8542.name: !-nys/color-%/surface
VariableID:3920:8542.description: Default surface. Frame background color, card background, and modal background. 🔎: default, base, page background, primary surface

VariableID:3920:8543.name: !-nys/color-%/surface-reverse
VariableID:3920:8543.description: Provides a strong contrast against {surface}. Used in the UNav footer. 🔎: darker shade, deep, background, dark section

VariableID:3920:8544.name: !-nys/color-%/surface-raised
VariableID:3920:8544.description: Provides a subtle contrast against {surface}. For use in the UNav Header: Trust Bar Dropdown Background, Language Dropdown Background 🔎: slight contrast, gray, light shade
